behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B1_independentContract: Phase1core§10.4 requires shipped GLBs to load with meshopt; converter header defines centred2.2-unit +Z device-screen format. These actual deployed binaries must construct a usable scene.
behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B2_realRegression: Skipping conversion of normalized Int16 vertex attributes before the node transform corrupts display bounds; the public loader+scene test fails for11actual slab GLBs with Device model display is not normalized.
behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B3_independentOracle: Actual committed binary assets and the independently documented converter format determine successful scene construction. Tests use production loadDeviceModel, not a separately configured loader or geometry-returning mock. Only native fetch/image decoding is isolated.
behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B4_stableSeam: loadDeviceModel followed by createImportedPhoneScene, exactly the production phoneViewer loading/installation path.
behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B5_refactorResistance: No dependency on bakeDisplayTransform export/name, buffer class or internal transform loop. Asset acceptance and required serialized display format remain valid if normalization moves or is rewritten.
behavioralBarOfSurvivingOwners.B6_uniqueProtection: Each asset file remains its own deployed-binary compatibility owner; together they also catch the concrete historical conversion omission, so the private helper test adds no necessary regression protection.

removedProductionSeam: bakeDisplayTransform export; implementation remains private and called by loadDeviceModel at the same owner. No other external production caller exists.
